acceptanceCriteria: --page path refusals name the flag and rule, covered by a focused CLI test.
body:
Source: claude/w7-corpus-input-path lane (V1-1226, GH #796).

Observed: an absolute `docs corpus maintain --page` still gets the generic 'maintenance requires a Markdown page outside Git metadata' instead of naming --page and the root-relative rule (DCP-V1-054 covers only the file-input flags).

Expected: the --page refusal names the flag and the violated rule, code unchanged.

completion.reason: Already delivered on origin/main by eaf09914ad6238c1a69a5071b14a179c57afadeb (spec requirement plus focused test cmd/corvint/docs_corpus_input_path_test.go); verified against acceptance criteria in the V1-2254 closeout audit 2026-10-21.

title: docs corpus maintain --page: name the flag in path refusals (V1-1226 follow-up)
